svg.title: Doric Order: half section · half elevation
svg.desc: Half section and half elevation of a fluted column with a cushion capital and annulets, carrying an entablature with triglyphs and metopes. Source: Proportions after Giacomo Barozzi da Vignola, Regola delli cinque ordini d’architettura (Rome, 1562). Simplified; drawn by Project Exodus.

g.text: SOURCE: Proportions after Giacomo Barozzi da Vignola, Regola
